sentences.en: Last Saturday, someone threw a cake at the Monalisa in the Botero Museum in Bogota, Colombia.
sentences.ko: 지난 토요일, 누군가가 콜롬비아 보고타에 있는 보테로 박물관의 ‘모나리자’에 케이크를 던졌다.

sentences.en: There were four eyewitnesses. What did they say?
sentences.ko: 네 명의 목격자가 있었다. 그들이 뭐라고 말했을까?

sentences.en: Read the following, and find the criminal.
sentences.ko: 다음을 읽고, 범인을 찾아보자.

sentences.en: Ann Jones, a visitor: I was looking at the Monalisa, and someone threw a cake at the painting.
sentences.ko: Ann Jones, 방문객: 저는 ‘모나리자’를 보고 있었는데, 누군가가 그림을 향해 케이크를 던졌어요.

sentences.en: I turned around and saw an old man.
sentences.ko: 저는 뒤를 돌아봤고 한 노인을 봤어요.

sentences.en: He was standing in front of a wheelchair.
sentences.ko: 그는 휠체어 앞에 서 있었어요.

sentences.en: I’m about 170 cm tall, and he was a little taller than me.
sentences.ko: 저는 키가 약 170 cm 정도인데, 그는 저보다 조금 더 컸어요.

sentences.en: Carlos Diaz, a janitor: An old man with gray hair was running away, and something fell off his head.
sentences.ko: Carlos Diaz, 청소부: 회색 머리의 한 노인이 도망가고 있었고, 그의 머리에서 뭔가가 떨어졌어요.

sentences.en: It was his wig.
sentences.ko: 그것은 그의 가발이었어요.

sentences.en: I ran after him, but I couldn’t catch him.
sentences.ko: 저는 그를 뒤쫓았지만, 잡지 못했어요.

sentences.en: He was faster than me.
sentences.ko: 그는 저보다 더 빨랐어요.

sentences.en: In fact, the old man was not old.
sentences.ko: 사실, 그 노인은 나이 든 사람이 아니었어요.

sentences.en: He was a young man with long brown hair.
sentences.ko: 그는 긴 갈색 머리의 젊은 남자였어요.

sentences.en: Diego Perez, a guard: I went to the crime scene, and there were pieces of cake all over the painting.
sentences.ko: Diego Perez, 경비원: 저는 범죄 현장에 갔는데, 그림 곳곳에 케이크 조각들이 있었어요.

sentences.en: There was also a wheelchair near the painting, and I found a cake box next to the wheelchair.
sentences.ko: 그림 근처에는 휠체어도 있었고, 저는 휠체어 옆에 있는 케이크 상자를 발견했어요.

sentences.en: The box was from Camila’s Bakery.
sentences.ko: 그 상자는 카밀라 빵집의 상자였어요.

sentences.en: Camila Santos, the owner of Camila’s Bakery: Last Friday, a young man came in.
sentences.ko: Camila Santos, 카밀라 빵집의 주인: 지난 금요일, 한 젊은 남자가 들어 왔어요.

sentences.en: I spoke to him in Spanish, but he didn’t understand me. He spoke only English.
sentences.ko: 저는 그에게 스페인어로 말했지만, 그는 제 말을 이해하지 못했어요. 그는 영어로만 말했어요.

sentences.en: We had a lot of different cakes, but he just wanted the smallest one.
sentences.ko: 우리 가게에는 많은 다른 케이크들이 있었는데, 그는 그냥 가장 작은 것을 원했어요.

sentences.en: We sold only one cake that day, so I remember him clearly.
sentences.ko: 우리는 그날 케이크를 딱 한 개 팔았어요. 그래서 그를 똑똑히 기억해요.

sentences.en: Oh, he had blue eyes.
sentences.ko: 아, 그의 눈은 파란색이었어요.

sentences.en: Now, look at the information about the suspects.
sentences.ko: 이제, 용의자들에 대한 정보를 보자.

sentences.en: Who threw the cake at the Monalisa?
sentences.ko: 누가 ‘모나리자’에게 케이크를 던졌을까?

prep.def: to send something through the air with your hand
prep.example: He **threw** the ball to his little sister.

prep.def: someone who saw a crime or an accident
prep.example: An **eyewitness** told the police about the car accident.
prep.example_ko: 한 목격자가 경찰에게 그 자동차 사고에 대해 말했다.

prep.ko: 다음에 말하는 것, 다음에 쓴 것
prep.def: the things that come next in a list or a text
prep.example: Read the **following** and choose the right answer.

prep.def: a person who does something against the law, like stealing or hurting others
prep.example: The **criminal** went to prison for ten years.

prep.def: a person who comes to see a place or a person
prep.example: Many **visitors** come to Jeju Island every summer.
prep.example_ko: 매년 여름 많은 방문객이 제주도에 온다.

prep.def: to move your body so that you face the other way
prep.example: She **turned around** when I called her name.

prep.def: close to the face side of something or someone
prep.example: Let’s meet **in front of** the library at three.

prep.def: a seat that moves on round parts, used by people who cannot walk
prep.example: My grandfather uses a **wheelchair** after his surgery.

prep.def: a small amount; slightly
prep.example: This soup is **a little** salty for me.

prep.def: a person in charge of cleaning and fixing things in a building
prep.example: The **janitor** fixed the broken door in our classroom.
prep.example_ko: 관리인이 우리 교실의 고장 난 문을 고쳤다.

prep.def: to leave a place or person secretly and suddenly
prep.example: The cat **ran away** from the big dog.

prep.def: to drop to the ground from a high object
prep.example: A book **fell off** my desk.
prep.example_ko: 책 한 권이 내 책상에서 떨어졌다.

prep.def: an object with hair on it that someone wears on their head
prep.example: The actor wore a long black **wig** on stage.
prep.example_ko: 그 배우는 무대에서 길고 검은 가발을 썼다.

prep.def: to follow someone quickly to get them
prep.example: The boy **ran after** the bus, but it left.

prep.def: to take and hold a person or thing that is moving
prep.example: Can you **catch** this ball with one hand?
prep.example_ko: 이 공을 한 손으로 잡을 수 있니?

prep.def: used to say what is really true
prep.example: He looks quiet, but **in fact** he talks a lot.
prep.example_ko: 그는 조용해 보이지만, 사실은 말을 많이 한다.

prep.def: a person whose job is to protect a person, place, or thing from danger or attack
prep.example: A **guard** stands at the gate of the building.

prep.def: the place where something happens
prep.example: Police cars came to the **scene** of the accident.

prep.def: a part that is cut or broken from something bigger
prep.example: Can I have a **piece** of pizza?

prep.def: very close to someone or something, at the side
prep.example: My best friend sits **next to** me in class.
prep.example_ko: 가장 친한 친구가 수업 시간에 내 옆에 앉는다.

prep.def: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold
prep.example: The new **bakery** sells fresh bread every morning.
prep.example_ko: 새 빵집은 매일 아침 신선한 빵을 판다.

prep.def: a person who has something
prep.example: The **owner** of this dog lives next door.

prep.def: to know the meaning of something
prep.example: I don’t **understand** this math problem.
prep.example_ko: 나는 이 수학 문제를 이해하지 못한다.

prep.def: in a way that is easy to see, hear, or know
prep.example: Please speak **clearly** so everyone can hear you.
prep.example_ko: 모두가 들을 수 있도록 또렷하게 말해 주세요.

prep.def: a person who is believed to be guilty of something
prep.example: The police asked the **suspect** many questions.
